answer: Each epoch, the registry pings all seats at an unannounced minute with a spoken phrase, and the operator must repeat it on live video within 90 seconds, checked by a liveness verifier that rejects recordings. If a seat misses the window, or two seats submit the same face or voice, both lose their payout and are revoked. An honest operator answers once from their phone, while a farm running 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 people ready at that unknown minute, at $25 each, $25,000 per round before one fake earns. An echo counts only from a real voice on a voyage, not a recording on the shale.
